description: Anduril YFQ-44A Fury class aircraft rebuilt as a parametric implicit model: Spline DF lofted outer mold line matched to public photographs, conventional or V tail, inlet duct, skin, frames, spars and ribs, engine envelope and fuel. Inputs are in ft, in and degrees; the model works in metres. X aft from the nose, Y to starboard, Z up.
